curation.notes: Custom magnetic tweezers measure condensation of a torsionally constrained 14 kb parS-containing DNA by B. subtilis ParB (WT and E111Q, S278C, T22C crosslinkable variants) by stepwise force reduction from 7 to 0.05 pN, plus a second MT assay of E. coli RNAP transcription through ParB-DNA condensates at constant 5 pN. Separate (non-correlative) flow-stretched DNA fluorescence imaging, FRAP, AFM imaging and MD simulations complement the force data.

evidence.snippet: a torsionally constrained construct was made by ligating, using T4 DNA ligase (NEB), the 14 kb DNA fragment to multi-Biotin and multi-Digoxigenin handle in a 1:10 ratio.
This resulted in handles of ∼600 bp in length with multi-biotin or multi-digoxigenin nucleotides present.

For wild type ParB, ParBE111Q and ParBS278C we first incubated the proteins for 15 min in the flow cell at such high force and directly after, the force was gradually reduced in steps (see Figure 1B) from 7 pN to 0.05 pN
